method: Every non-reprint card from Lorwyn Eclipsed through Reality Fracture (and their Commander decks) was checked against the 20 most recently updated Bracket 2-3 Eriette decks on Moxfield and EDHREC's Eriette pages, then filtered for Auras on opponents' creatures and drain. Game Changers excluded.
summary: Eriette drains for each Aura you control. Strixhaven's Commander decks added several Aura cards that recent Eriette lists already run (Killian, Scriv, Eiganjo Dynastorian). The badge on each card counts the sources that include it; "Claude's pick" means no list runs it yet.

sets.name: EDHREC Recommendations
sets.note: Cards Eriette players commonly run in Bracket 2 and 3 that aren't in your deck, from EDHREC's bracket pages and average decks. Game Changers removed (Farewell, Enlightened Tutor, Teferi's Protection, Vampiric Tutor, Demonic Tutor, Bolas's Citadel, The One Ring, Smothering Tithe, Serra's Sanctum). Sorted by how often they're played.

picks.name: Scriv, the Obligator
picks.why: Flying deathtouch, and it puts a Contract aura token on an opponent's creature every time it enters or attacks. Each one is another Aura for Eriette's drain and another creature that can't attack you.
